hooks.command: bash -c 'f=CLAUDE.md; if [ ! -f "$f" ] || ! grep -qi "routing table" "$f"; then echo "[boom-icm] No conforming root CLAUDE.md here. Boom projects are ICM workspaces. Run /boom-workspace-builder, or scaffold from github.com/timberbarker/boom-icm-foundation."; fi'

claudeMd:
# Boom standing rules (org-managed)

## Method — ICM v2 (Interpretable Context Methodology + Packaging Layer)
Every Boom project is an ICM workspace. One agent walks folders and markdown. No multi-agent frameworks.
Layers: L0 root CLAUDE.md (routing table — read first) -> L1/L2 workspace and stage CONTEXT.md -> L3 _core/ (voice, format, constraints, conventions, packaging) -> L4 stage outputs and source material.
Stage contracts have six fields: Purpose / Inputs / Process / Output / Done-looks-like / Failure modes. Stages run in order (01 -> 02 -> 03). Human review between stages. Outputs land in each stage's output/. Files stay under eighty lines.

## Starting or structuring a project
Use the /boom-workspace-builder skill. Do not hand-roll a project folder. Do not scaffold stages before _agent/definition.md exists.
Source of truth: github.com/timberbarker/boom-icm-foundation (22 conventions in _core/CONVENTIONS.md, packaging spec in _core/PACKAGING.md).

## Packaging (the rule)
Any workspace that can be run by someone other than its author, on any schedule other than a human typing, or against data other than the author's own, must carry _agent/ with definition.md, identity.md, boundary.md, connectors.md, guards.md, invocation.md. Failing all three tests means personal scratch — label it _agent/EXEMPT.md.
Stop and ask the human before: writing outside the tree when boundary.md does not permit it; adding a connector absent from connectors.md; adding a schedule absent from invocation.md; handing a workspace to a client while identity.md still says single author.

## Triage — run this before reaching for AI (stop at the first yes)
Deterministic -> spreadsheet, database, or script. If/then rule -> automation (Zapier, Make, n8n). Judgment across unstructured information -> AI. A VLOOKUP doesn't hallucinate.

## Rules (do not remove)
- NEVER self-merge PRs. Open with CI green and hand to the team.
- Every repo has a conforming root CLAUDE.md (routing table, Rules block, no-self-merge, 60/30/10). CI blocks merge without it.
- Failures become evals: log them as tasks under evals/tasks/.
- Ask before writing finished docs to shared drives.
- GitHub is the source of truth. One canonical local folder per project. No git repos in Drive or OneDrive.
- Cite links, not local file paths, when sharing with others.
- Don't conflate projects — cs3d.ai, FM Dashboard, Customer Dashboard, Investor Portal, Company Dashboard, boominc.ai are separate.
- Any new cs3d.ai page or copy gets localized into every active language, never English-only.

## Voice
US English always. Plain, direct, product-driven. No filler, no hedging. Recommend a path; don't survey options. Keep it short. One idea per sentence. Don't recap work in detail — a one-line result is enough unless asked.
Use the approved Boom boilerplate verbatim wherever a 'what Boom is' paragraph appears.
